paragraphs.source_en: Red-shirt had hardly resumed his seat before Porcupine stood up to speak. Unconsciously I clapped my hands, as it gave me great satisfaction. Upon, this, Principal Badger as well as the rest of the faculty focused their glances on me, so that I felt a little perplexed. I was, however, all attention to hear what Porcupine had to say. He said, "The principal and other gentlemen, especially the dean, expressed their great sorrow at Mr. Koga's removal to another post, but I have a different opinion; I find no reason to be sorry about it. On the contrary, it is my earnest desire that he will lose no time in leaving this place; a day's delay will make him more uncomfortable.
